automationz. Haz twelve slotz dat

itemz per stack, an cooldown
delay. Three stack-comparison

too. When ready to drop but
still waitin fer outside signal,
it opens da shutter ahead of
time. All matching stackz drop
together, yiss! Hover over

outside signal sez so. §9OR§7: Filter-matching stuff dropz by
itself; other stuff needs outside triggur. §9IGNORE§7: Outside
Redstone gets ignored completely (outside triggur stays active).

Filter-combinashun gate logic§r §9AND§7: Drop da stackz
named by da filterz when ALL filterz iz green.
§9OR§7: Each green filter gets its own stack dropped.

Outside Redstone signal blinkie
§7(click fer one paw-made triggur).

Triggur style§r §9Pulsy§7: One drop each time
outside signal goes NAW->YISS. §9Keep-going§7:
Keep droppin while outside signal iz YISS.

Drop zoominess (slow to fast) §7Spring pre-squish
iz low at da bottom position an high at da top.

Huperr fer fancy factory automationz.

biggest scoop area iz 9x9. GUI
sliderz set: - Scoop reach (0 to
4) - Insert wait (0.5s to 10s)

stuff thru. Can grab itemz frum
its input side an put itemz in
da inventory by its output side.

than a heated cobblestone
furnace. First-in-first-out queues
an feederz move whole stackz.

Put a Huperr in an extra slot fer
automatically grabbin stuff frum

Extra slot §7Put a Huperr here fer

inside tank can hold three bucketz.

infinite-water-source makin, yiss.

into Frozen water, den Pack'd
Frozen Water, an finally Big
blu. Click wif a water bucket or
pipe water in; make sure da
gadget haz RF powah. Use a Huperr
or another item extractor

signal to stop da freezie. Fer
automation, a Redstone thingy
comparator can tell which ice

moar done wif da fuel. Two extra

output, an fuel each haz a two-stack

inside. Add an external heater in an
extra slot an hook up powah fer an
electric smeltin-speed boost, yiss.

furnace fer meltin stonez.§r

magma blukz, den into lava.

automation, a Redstone thingy
comparator can tell which meltin
stage da mineral haz reached.

inside charge-pump circuit

often. How much it makes depends
on time of day an weather.
Click fer charge level, powah
made, an work-progress peeks.
Chops grown treez in front of its workin face. It does NOT scoop da dropz. Gib a redstone signal fer makin it stop, kitty.

slotz inside. Insert stuff

stuff until da queue haz no room

burned. Gib electrical RF/FE
powah fer faster processin.

again to take dat guardrail away.

Sideways ceiling-support beam piece fer ur buildinz.

Fancy steel covering fer floorz, lined up wif

Sturdy steel tabal wif four legz, kthx.

Straight bit of flooid pipe. Flooid
only goes one way thru it. No
sideways connections, an it slows

Straight bit of flooid pipe.

it won't connect sideways.
Tiptoe-place fer da reverse
direction. No redstone powah means

Straight flooid pipe bit fer
one-way flow only; no connections

Steel piece fer da top cap or bottom

Straight hollow pole piece

Steel piece fer da top cap or bottom

Straight pole piece as wide

Wood piece dat fits da top or

Strong wooden support piece fer

jei.info.immersive_engineer_decor_contro: Diamond-grade engineer multi-toolz. Plonks torches frum ur inventory; tiptoein lets u do axe, shovel, hoe, an Skizzors work. Tiptoe-break a log fer fellin connected logz. Diamonds in kraftin can repair it, even past full durability, kitty.
Portable ore-processin hamr. Craftin recipez damage it an return da same tool. Smackin a target wif da hamr knocks it back.
Tracker storez a bluk position inside teh item. Click bluk 2 save dimension an coordinates. Tooltip showz saved spot. Sneak-use Tracker 2 clear target.
Marker toolz dat stacks only one high, wif 100 usez. Successful placement puts an arrow marker on a sturdy face an costs durability. Failed placement dun wear da item at all, meow.

Auto Stim Pack iz emergency healz tool fer danger maintenance. Use manually 2 heal, get brief protect, an short speed boost. In inventoree it can also trigger automatic at low health, den enter cooldown.
Sleepin Bag iz weatherproof nap kit fer werk far frum bed. Use at nite in Overworld 2 rest till mornin. It no set or move ur spawn point. Bag sayz no in daytime, near monsters, or in bad dimension.

Material Box carryz big stash of one plain, unchanged, stackable buildin material. Hold box in main paw an material stack in off paw 2 load it. Use box wif empty off paw 2 pull one stack out. Box holdz up 2 512 itemz of one type.
Divin Air Capsule iz emergency air stash fer underwater werk. Use it urself 2 refill air. In inventoree it can also trigger automatic when air iz almost gone, den enter cooldown.

Muslee Bar Press turnz common noms into compact field rations. Bring bread, apple, an wheat, melon, pumpkin, beetroot, or Industrial Hemp seed, den use press. Gud press eats one of each, checkz output room, makes four Muslee Melange Power Bars, an hurts press durability.
Fast enginur ration made by Muslee Bar Press or its recipe, nom.
Turns blu stuffz into Charged Blu Stuffz by spendin one XP levl, a lil health, an causin hunger exhaustion. Low-health use gets NOPE, kitty.
Keeps one XP levl as an item. Use it fer gettin a levl, clearing fire an negative effects, an healin a lil bit, meow.
Engineer-tool material fer da reconstructed kraftin set, kitty.
Engineer-tool material fer da reconstructed kraftin set, kitty.
Metal werkbench wif dedicated hamr slot, 3x3 craftin grid, an output slot. JEI showz it as craftin catalyst.
Lil coal-fired furnace haz input, fuel, output, FIFO buffer, an extra slotz. JEI shows it as a smeltin catalyst, meow.
Powered furnace haz input, output, FIFO buffers, an extra slot. JEI shows it as a smeltin catalyst, kitty.
Heats accepted mineral input into magma bluk output an makes lava on da side. Can also cool stored lava into obsidian, yiss.
Cold-processin machine fer da freezie conversions implemented by da bluk entity, includin water-bucket handlin an ice upgradez, kitty.
Lil flooid-storage bluk fer da machine flooid system, meow.
Picks up supported flooid frum da world into da machine flooid system, kitty.
Passively gathers water fer da machine flooid system, yiss.
Lil powah source fer da side of ur machine, meow.
Gets milk frum cowz into its own milk stash an can send it to tankz or containers dat accept it, kitty.
Factory stuff-mover fer scoopin an shifting itemz, wif adjustable reach an redstone behaviorz.
Factory stuff-mover spits out buffered itemz as its filter an redstone settingz say, kitty.
Factory stuff-mover plonks filtered blukz or itemz frum its inside stash, meow.
Lil buster harvests da target bluk into its own drop buffer, instead of droppin itemz straight into da world, kitty.
Lil tree chopper harvests connected logz into its own drop buffer when da work cycle finishes, meow.
